solutions.title: Count length then walk to the middle
solutions.strategy: First count the nodes, then walk length / 2 steps from the head and return that original node.

timeComplexity.explanation: The list is scanned once to count nodes and a second partial scan walks to the middle, which remains linear overall.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only counters and traversal pointers are stored while the original chain is reused.

solutions.title: Slow and fast pointers
solutions.strategy: Advance one pointer one step and another pointer two steps so the slow pointer lands on the required middle.

timeComplexity.explanation: The fast pointer traverses the list once, and the slow pointer advances at most half as many times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only two traversal pointers are stored while reusing the original chain.
